elementNameContains.description: Filter where the element name must contain the keyword if specified

elementNameOrDescriptionContains.description: Filter where the element name or description must contain the keyword if specified

elementType.description: Filter where the element must be of this type if specified

includeHidden.description: Filter if hidden elements should be included or not

consumerPortfolioKeys.description: Filter by one or more portfolio keys

limit.description: Limits the number of returned elements

sort.description: Sorts the returned elements by the specified field

sortAscending.description: Specifies if the sort order should be ascending or descending

assetFilters.description: Filters which asset elements to search by

key.description: Key of the application to filter by

digest.description: Digest of the application to filter by, if empty will use the latest revision
